claims_requiring_current_verification: The statement that online business becomes simpler once one understands a core concept.
Assertion that one can make $100,000 or more per month with the right business.

intended_organization_or_user: Individuals looking to generate income through online businesses or side hustles.
major_ideas: Many believe making money online is complicated due to perceived barriers like tech skills, experience, and costs.
Identifying the actual business product or service is crucial, while marketing methods are merely tools to generate leads.
Creating an online course is a potential high-profit business opportunity, provided there is valuable content to offer.
prerequisites: Willingness to put in time and effort to launch a business.
A clear idea or skill to offer as a product or service.
Basic understanding of marketing to get leads and sales.
proposed_workflow: Identify your product or service to offer.
Create a funnel for guiding prospects through the purchasing process.
Generate leads through free content on platforms like YouTube or social media.
Offer free or low-cost initial products to build a customer base.
Upsell additional products or services through one-time offers (OTOs).
Utilize email marketing for further engagement and conversion.
tools_templates_resources: Platforms like Kajabi and Teachable for course creation.
Free email marketing tools for follow-up campaigns.
